title: Need help

gotItMiddle: . Our support team will reply to

intro: Tell us what happened. For a booking, add its number (like SB7K3Q9X). We see your salon with your message and reply by email.
subjectPlaceholder: A booking, payouts, my listing, the app…
atLeastEvenWithFile: At least {min} characters, even with a file
filesStillUploading: Send works once your files have finished uploading.
fileFailed: A file didn't go up: try it again or remove it.

emailFiles.other: 📎 {count} files sent by email (only in that email: we see them there)

emailFilesMore.one: 📎 {count} more file sent by email (only in that email: we see it there)

notFoundBody: It may belong to another account.
asked: Asked {when}. Our replies also come by email.

sentReply: Sent. Our support team will read it and reply.
photoTooBigUnreadable: This photo is over 10 MB in a format that can't be shrunk here. Send a screenshot of it, or set the camera to JPEG ("Most compatible").
photoTooBig: This photo is too big (over 10 MB). Take it again or send a screenshot.
videoTooBig: {name} is {size}, over 100 MB. Send a shorter clip (under a minute on most phones).

fileTooBig: {name} is {size}, over 10 MB. Send a smaller one (a video can be up to 100 MB).

tooManyFiles.one: At most {max} files in one message, so {names} wasn't added: send it in the next one.
tooManyFiles.other: At most {max} files in one message, so {names} weren't added: send them in the next one.

attachedAsFile: Attached as a file (it can't be shown here, only downloaded) · {size} · goes when you tap Send
attached: Attached · {size} · goes when you tap Send
mostForOneMessage: That's the most for one message: send the rest in the next one.
fileRemoved: removed (files are kept for 6 months after a request is resolved or last written on)
tapFullSize: Tap to see it full size (opens in a new tab)
writeHint: We see your salon with your message and reply by email.
